sources.title: Edo
sources.author: Memory Alpha contributors
sources.access_method: Public pleasures, law and protective entity sections read
sources.read_scope: Rubicun III has a peaceful pleasure-oriented humanoid society and lethal punishment zones.
sources.limitations: Pleasure and protection do not specify automated production or allocation. The humanoid and three-legged animated species are not confused.

sources.title: Cooperative
sources.author: Memory Alpha contributors
sources.access_method: Public origins, communal garden, shortage and new-link sections read
sources.read_scope: Former drones undertake real rebuilding and grow their own food amid shortages.
sources.limitations: Communal sharing is not automatically technologically displaced labor. Eighty thousand arrivals are not eighty thousand nonworkers.

sources.title: Hologram
sources.author: Memory Alpha contributors
sources.access_method: Lokirrim enslaved-photonic and decompilation paragraph read
sources.read_scope: The Lokirrim enslave holograms and later destroy encountered photonics during conflict.
sources.limitations: Sectoral replacement and suppression are clear, but the checked account does not establish the humanlike population’s distribution or replacement-labor economy.

sources.title: Pralor
sources.author: Memory Alpha contributors
sources.access_method: Public Pralor/Cravic builders, planned dismantling and continued robot war sections read
sources.read_scope: Automated military units kill their creators and continue the war.
sources.limitations: The frozen Novan discovery label is unverified; the concise reference identifies Pralor and Cravic. Extinct builders are not leisure residents.

sources.title: Allocator
sources.author: Memory Alpha contributors
sources.access_method: Public TC, colored-care levels and Jye administrator sections read
sources.read_scope: An AI rations treatment by assessed social usefulness under hospital administration.
sources.limitations: Automatic rationing is not itself replacement of medical labor or proof of a post-work economy; the biological administrator remains relevant.

sources.title: Quarra
sources.author: Memory Alpha contributors
sources.access_method: Public industrial setting and labor-shortage passages read
sources.read_scope: The industrial system suffers a severe actual shortage of workers.
sources.limitations: Real staffing demand is not evidence of intentionally dispensable employment or general work-independent access.

sources.title: Tinker Tenor Doctor Spy
sources.author: Memory Alpha contributors
sources.access_method: Public superior consulting the Hierarchy about attack approval read
sources.read_scope: Hierarchical approval of a proposed resource raid.
sources.limitations: Operational consultation does not establish civilian AI welfare, universal resources or productive ownership.

sources.title: HD25 Isomorphic Projection
sources.author: Memory Alpha contributors
sources.access_method: Public labor and Dejaren example read
sources.limitations: One ship’s artificial worker does not establish the entire species’ distribution or its organic population’s work independence.

sources.title: Hirogen training facility
sources.author: Memory Alpha contributors
sources.access_method: Public technology transfer and repeatable holographic hunts sections read
sources.read_scope: Holographic prey replace some physical hunting encounters.
sources.limitations: Entertainment and training simulation are not general material production or universal support.

sources.title: Replicator
sources.author: Memory Alpha contributors
sources.access_method: Public food synthesis and commonplace Alpha Quadrant use paragraphs read
sources.read_scope: Replicators exist in the Ferengi Alliance as well as other advanced societies.
sources.limitations: Common availability does not establish equal access, universal support or a policy retaining technologically dispensable jobs. Individual Ferengi on another planet do not establish Alliance institutions.

sources.title: Star Trek 101: The Dominion
sources.author: Jay Stobie / StarTrek.com
sources.access_method: Public coalition, Vorta administrative labor and engineered-soldier explanation read
sources.read_scope: Biological subordinates perform real administration, infrastructure and military functions.
sources.limitations: Genetic engineering and cloning are not automatically autonomous robotic production; the Founders’ personal withdrawal from daily administration is not universal leisure.

sources.title: Coppelius Station
sources.author: Memory Alpha contributors
sources.access_method: Public Maddox/Soong and organic-synth community paragraphs read
sources.read_scope: A small community of synthetic persons has human scientists and advanced tools.
sources.limitations: Synthetic personhood and a settlement do not establish resource allocation. Unverified citation-needed mortality details are not used.

sources.title: Fundamental field replicator
sources.author: Memory Alpha contributors
sources.access_method: Public neurocotamic tool and La Sirena repair example read
sources.read_scope: A thought-directed material tool helps repair a ship.
sources.limitations: One tool demonstration does not establish universal household entitlement or idle personhood.

decisions.reason: Edo leisure and social peace do not establish automatic material provision.
decisions.analysis: A pleasure-oriented society and protective super-entity do not supply production, allocation or participation rules.

decisions.reason: The Unity Cooperative performs real rebuilding and communal food production under shortage.
decisions.analysis: Collective sharing and neural healing do not prove that technology displaced the necessary labor of its members.

decisions.reason: Lokirrim photonic slavery and suppression do not establish the wider material economy.
decisions.analysis: The restriction could support a zero-variant comparison if the relevant labor-replacement economy were clear; the short reference does not supply that scope.
decisions.follow_up: Skip deeper lore; preserve suppression as an unscored lead.

decisions.reason: The Prototype reference identifies Pralor/Cravic war machines after their builders’ extinction, not a supported humanlike civilian society.
decisions.analysis: The discovery label Novan is unverified and is not carried into an invented economic record. Machines continuing war are active workers, not nonworking extinct creators.
decisions.follow_up: Keep the corrected reference identity without editing the frozen catalogue.

decisions.reason: The Allocator automates medical rationing, but does not establish replacement of care labor or a post-work material order.
decisions.analysis: TC-based access is clear and unequal; a computer choosing recipients is not by itself an automatic provider of the treatment.
decisions.follow_up: Keep the allocation comparison without forcing a post-work record.

decisions.reason: Quarra’s actual labor shortage and useful industrial work are not a demonstrated zero variant.
decisions.analysis: Coercive recruitment does not show that the demanded labor is dispensable or that necessities are otherwise chiefly allocated without it.

decisions.reason: Hierarchy approval of raids does not establish a general civilian production and distribution system.
decisions.analysis: Computer consultation and bureaucratic command can govern real labor without providing work-independent necessities.

decisions.reason: Serosian shipboard holographic labor does not establish the species’ household material access.
decisions.analysis: A technological worker can replace tasks without establishing society-wide labor independence.

decisions.reason: Hirogen holographic hunts are a sectoral simulation system rather than verified post-work provisioning.
decisions.analysis: Simulated prey and repeated hunting do not establish ordinary food, housing, ownership or access for a supported community.

decisions.reason: Ferengi replicator availability does not establish work-independent access or a documented employment-preservation regime.
decisions.analysis: Technical capacity, profit culture and actual work must not be merged into an unsupported claim that the work is knowingly dispensable.
decisions.follow_up: Skip broad series reconstruction; reopen only for a clear economic reference.

decisions.reason: Dominion biological castes perform useful administrative, infrastructure and military labor.
decisions.analysis: Cloning subordinated persons and elite withdrawal from daily work are not autonomous production or a general post-work support system.
decisions.follow_up: Keep as a biological caste-labor comparison.

decisions.reason: Coppelius has synthetic persons and advanced repair tools but no verified household access constitution in the quick check.
decisions.analysis: Material replication and synthetic life demonstrate capacity, without the community’s actual allocation or participation rules.

review_notes: Twelve fast Star Trek dispositions; no new record is forced from sectoral automation or AI regulation alone.
The Prototype discovery identity is corrected in the decision while the frozen queue remains intact.
Quarra’s labor shortage, communal gardening and biological engineered labor remain actual work. A medical allocator is not automatically an automated doctor.
No full episode viewing or transcript read. Unrelated fan-forum Dominion hits were discarded in favor of the official guide.
